test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, E, F, G, Q, R and S, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit to the right of R. Only two people sit between R and E. Only one person sits between E and F. F sits to the immediate left of R. S sits to the immediate right of Q. How many people sit between Q and G?
solution:
**Given: **Six people, E, F, G, Q, R and S, are sitting in a row facing north (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit to the right of R. Only two people sit between R and E. Only one person sits between E and F. F sits to the immediate left of R. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad8d8ae47aedeb34af77befc71c431f083d92e7af09fa55dbb95beaf2499726.png] 

S sits to the immediate right of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbfbc0ff454e1cf16c40410c9aa35d0f02da0a305fb659d0abb51fe3aaa24941.png] 

Thus, Only two people sit between Q and G.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
